text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Trade ministry ferries more foodstuffs to local markets
- Oil-for-food deal is victory for Iraq and defeat for America
- Japan is keen to buy Iraqi crude
- More than 150 foreign companies have agreed to take part in a food industries fair to be held in Baghdad in mid-December
- Culture and information minister receives Arab poets
- William Perry says threats to our presence in the Gulf are still there
- Libya to ship foodstuffs to Iraq
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
